rules.summary: Children under 16 may work at most 9 hours a day and 54 a week, 6 a.m.-9 p.m.

citation.title: Idaho Code § 44-1304 — Working hours for children under sixteen
citation.excerpt: more than fifty-four (54) hours in any one week, nor more than nine (9) hours in any one day; nor before the hour of six o'clock in the morning nor after the hour of nine o'clock in the evening
